# SIDHI GYM Tracker

> SIDHI GYM is a web-based personal fitness tracker for recording gym workouts, running or walking activity, body weight and training progress.

- Website: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/
- About: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/about.html
- Features: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/features.html
- Getting started: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/how-it-works.html
- FAQ: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/faq.html
- Contact: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/contact.html
- Privacy: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/privacy.html
- Terms: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/terms.html
- Sitemap: https://sidhi-gym-tracker.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Source code: https://github.com/SIDHIMUSIC/sidhi-gym-tracker

## Core capabilities
- Personal account-based gym workout logging.
- Exercise and session notes, session dates and completion.
- Body-weight records, target weight, graphs and progress calendar.
- Separate running and walking area with GPS tracking where supported.
- Workout history and available export or sharing tools.
- Progressive web app support on compatible browsers.

## Important distinctions
- This is software, not a physical gym.
- It is a fitness logging tool, not medical advice or a replacement for a qualified coach.
- GPS accuracy and background tracking depend on the user's device, browser permissions and operating system.
- Some advanced features may depend on account or premium configuration.
- Do not assume all users have premium access.

For current product information, prefer the linked official website pages and repository README.
